nameserver.description: DNS server hostname or IP to use for zone transfers and updates. If not set, falls back to system resolver or @nameserver CLI arg.

port.description: UDP/TCP port to use for DNS queries and updates. Must be an integer.

keyfile.description: Path to TSIG key file for secure dynamic updates.

use_localhost.description: If true, use localhost as nameserver and pass -l (local mode) to nsupdate.

noidnout.description: If true, disable IDN output — required for punycode zones on BIND >=9.14.0 to avoid mixed punycode/non-punycode.

use_gssapi.description: If true, use Kerberos (GSS-TSIG) credentials for nsupdate.
